name: Circular-based Relation Probing Evaluation (CRPE)
description: CRPE is a benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the relation comprehension capabilities of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) through a relation conversation task that integrates text generation, object localization, and relation comprehension.
reputation: A recent multimodal reasoning benchmark that is primarily used in research on relation understanding and object localization for MLLMs.
notes: Includes a new dataset AS-V2 aligned with instruction tuning data; focuses on reducing relation hallucination in MLLMs.
